stations.title: Ailsa
stations.say: Who is on the wrong channel?

stations.title: Radio log
stations.text: The same teams again and again, in a heap.

stations.title: Ailsa
stations.say: Now I know who to call.

captions: A busy night, and Ailsa thinks someone unknown is on the team's channel.
Today the log repeats the same teams so often that a stranger is easy to miss.
You use sets to drop repeats, remember what was heard, and compare groups.
Now the call sign nobody knows stands out, once, in order.
Sets, add, in, and what two groups share or do not.
